reviews.text: I want to start by sharing my deep gratitude to Bee. We just adopted our pup Ernest last week and he had been brought up from Texas with severe matting, we have no idea how long it had been since he had been groomed so she was already working with a big project (first pic)! Not only that, but he is still getting used to the city, and new people have been a challenge. Bee immediately made him and us feel comfortable for this first appointment where we didn't really know what to expect in terms of his reaction to being left at a groomer. She clearly knew what she was doing as she walked us through what we should do with the fur. He had also been neutered a couple of weeks ago and she was so careful around his sensitive areas. When we picked him up, she showed us some videos of him during the service, he was so calm and really liked being with her!! You can tell she has a true connection with animals. She did Ernest the biggest service a groomer and human being can do, she made him feel comfortable and gave him so much relief from all the fur and dirt and sadness he was carrying. He seems to feel so much lighter. I'm so thankful that we found her and will be coming back for sure! Also everybody else at reception was also extremely welcoming and easy to communicate with. Overall just can't say thank you enough and sing Bee's praises over the moon. Also, she gave us this really cute sticker / photo of him.
Lovely establishment with friendly and professional staff. Very clean! I’m so happy I found it
All of here at the New York Dog Spa and Hotel 25th Street thank you for this amazing review!

Sarah, this review means so much to all of us here at the New York Dog Spa and Hotel - 25th Street! We love Hampton and are so happy that we have gotten to see him come out of his shell over the past few years. We can't wait to see you guys next time!

The price is worth it. Mia leaves happy. Thank you

Bee is an amazing groomer - highly recommend! She is extremely professional and friendly and put my slightly nervous pup at ease before his groom. She did a perfect job grooming him - he looks amazing and Bee even sent me home with an adorable sticker of him! We can’t wait to see Bee again!
Our Shih Tzu, Artie, loves his spa date with Bee! She does great work every time!
Bee is the absolute best. She’s precise, consistent and kind. Our dog loves her!

I’ve been going to NY Dog Spa for the past 5 years, and I truly can’t recommend them enough.

The manager, Audrey, is incredible. After my dog went through major spinal surgery in 2023, I stopped by just to pick up a treat—and she surprised us with a big Lamb Chop stuffed toy to cheer him up. It was such a thoughtful, unforgettable gesture, and honestly, he looked just like it 🥹

For grooming, I only trust Bee. My dog is a senior with a history of spinal injury, arthritis, and now dementia, so finding someone who truly understands how to care for him hasn’t been easy. Bee has been absolutely amazing—patient, gentle, and so attentive to his needs. I wouldn’t go to anyone else.

If you have a senior dog or just want a place that genuinely cares, this is it.
This review is specifically for the groomer, Alex. They are a master! My dog is not a particularly easy dog to groom and they do an amazing job. Very talented and communicative.

This is Oliver- doesn’t he look cute? He comes all the way from New Jersey to see Alex, who always does an amazing job. Alex and the team make Oliver feel really welcome and special. We can’t recommend Alex (and New York Dog Spa) enough!
Bee is the kindest groomer a dog owner may wish for. Highly recommended for precision cuts.
Alejandra is a fantastic groomer. Our pup Pepe loves her, and he always looks great. Highly recommended!

Great staff -great skills with all dogs. I trust them with my dog for boarding playing and bathing! They do it all with pleasure-,ease and efficiency! Milo's "go to place" for excellent services as needed💕 …

I was hesitant to leave a negative review, but after years of boarding my dog at Dog Spa for extended stays, I felt compelled to share my experience to help better inform fellow dog owners. The 25th Street facility has always felt somewhat spartan—especially considering the premium pricing—but I chose to overlook that because the staff consistently presented themselves well.

This most recent two-week boarding stay, however, left me genuinely concerned. Even before picking up my dog, I was startled by the daily photos the staff sent while I was traveling in Europe; at one point, I honestly wondered if they had accidentally photographed a different dog. It became increasingly clear that my dog was losing a significant amount of weight. I had pre-portioned his meals into daily baggies with precise measurements and feeding instructions, and I never received any indication that he wasn’t eating.

When we brought him home, we were shocked by his condition. He had lost five pounds in two weeks—dropping from a healthy 28 lbs to just 23 lbs. His ribs, hip bones, and spine were noticeably protruding, and it was alarming how much smaller he looked. He also had a semi-healed vertical bite mark on the right side of his head, which may have been the result of rough play with other dogs.

To be clear, my intention is not to bash Dog Spa. I understand the challenges of closely monitoring individual dogs when they are placed in a general playgroup environment each day. However, the significant weight loss during this stay has forced us to reconsider using Dog Spa for any future long-term boarding.

The staff members we’ve interacted with have always been kind, and it’s evident that they care about the pets. That makes writing this review all the more disappointing. Still, for anyone considering boarding their dog for more than a few days, I would strongly recommend exploring other options.

Update:
I was promptly contacted by two managers from DogSpa following my post. Both were very apologetic, willing to listen to my concerns, and reassured me that they would implement new procedures with their staff to avoid similar issues in the future. They also immediately offered to reimburse me for the entirety of my most recent stay!—something I hadn’t even requested. It’s clear from my discussions with them that the team at DogSpa genuinely takes the safety of the pets in their care very seriously.

The New York Dog Spa & Hotel is one of the first prestigious dog boarding facilities that treat pets at a higher level than the average kennel. They also offer grooming, training & some essential pet accessories besides boarding. We know our client's dogs love going to this facility as they are practically running to the door each time.
My dog Mila absolutely loves to come to NY Dog Spa & Hotel on 25th Street. The staff is always very friendly and welcoming. My dog gets so very excited every time she comes in for daycare.

I took my golden retriever Palmer for a haircut. I am extremely particular with his haircut as it’s hard to groom goldens because of their feathers and making it flow seamlessly.  Gina did a fabulous job. Palmer looks so great.

My pup has been coming here every single day for over 5 years, starting when she was just 6 months old, and I’ve never had a single issue or complaint. If you’re looking for a safe and reliable place to board your dog, this is it. They offer an amazing monthly rate and convenient hours: 8AM to 8PM on weekdays and 9AM to 5PM on weekends. A special shoutout to Rachel, who takes such incredible care of my dog and has truly become a friend over the years.
Ashna, thank you for your 5 star review of us here at the New York Dog Spa and Hotel! Penny was perfect on the grooming table. We hope you guys come by again soon!

Thank you Allison for your 5 star review of us here at the New York Dog Spa and Hotel - 25th Street! Rocky loves staying with us and playing with all of his friends. We can't wait to see you guys again soon!

Bradley groomed my 1 yo standard poodle and did an AMAZING job.  Most importantly, Ziggy was super relaxed and clearly enjoyed himself.  Perfect length, even all over, and did a great job on head (I do a straight one-length very short cut - no pom pons).  Cleaned his ears without causing any itchy/irritation (which happens often).  Thank you, Bradley!!
Been coming here for boarding and grooming for nearly 14 years. Always pleased with the service, care and attention our dog has received from NY Dog Spa

After 5+ years of bringing Amélie here, I can confidently say New York Dog Spa on 25th is one of her favorite places. What sets them apart is their genuine love for the dogs in their care. Every visit, without fail, the entire staff greets us warmly, and Amélie receives hugs and snuggles from everyone.

Their dedication to keeping pet parents updated is remarkable. They share delightful photos throughout the day – from Amélie with her furry friends in the back to her bath time moments and every stage of the grooming process, right up to the final brush. They're consistently proactive with both email and phone communications.

We keep coming back because it's clear that Amélie isn't just another client – she's truly loved and cherished by every team member. As a long-time customer, I can't recommend them highly enough for anyone looking for a place where their dog will receive genuine care and attention.
